options.content: **Traces are wired but empty until the apps emit spans.** On each Coolify service set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://10.200.2.57:4318`, `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=<name>`, `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp`. Flow: `app → Alloy(10.200.2.57) → OTel Collector(.52) → Jaeger`; RED metrics (`traces_spanmetrics_*`) are derived automatically. See [docs/dev-dashboards.md].
